significance: A Shiva shrine on Dakini Hill about 13 km from Guwahati where a hill stream runs continuously over the lingam; devotees hold it to be one of the twelve Jyotirlingas, an identification scholars dispute. Maha Shivaratri is its principal observance.
story: The Shiva Purana account told here has Shiva destroying the demon Bhimasura when he attacked King Priyadharman at worship, the stream over the lingam being Shiva's perspiration from that fight.
